Column no 7 (Dig_IO_States) in the measurement files contains a numerical integer value representing the state of several digital input and output signals in the wind turbine controller system.

The integer number is the sum of the values of the bits that are logical 1. See table below. For example: If bit 0, 4 and 12 is logical 1, and all other bits are 0, the integer value in the file will be 1+16+4096=4113.
